title: Your Retriever Already Knows: Distribution-Shape QPP for RAG Retrieval Sufficiency
abstract: arXiv:2609.11646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines often provide no reliable inference-time signal of whether retrieval succeeded; on ambiguous or out-of-scope queries, generation may then hallucinate. Motivated by a Czech nuclear-regulator deployment where data sensitivity precludes third-party LLM APIs, we compare three Query Performance Prediction (QPP) paradigms for retrieval sufficiency in RAG: score-based features, a content-based LLM judge, and a hybrid. On the eight ViDoRe vision domains (14,514 queries), our 24 non-lexical features (GeneralQPP; 15 distribution-shape, 5 query-surface, 4 global) reach a weighted-average AUROC of 0.856 at 2 ms per query, ahead of a classic-QPP literature pool (Classic Full, 0.835) and well above a local Qwen3.5 LLM judge (0.649, +0.207 gap; $\sim$3000$\times$ faster and cheaper per query). translated_title: 你的检索器早已知晓：用于RAG检索充分性判断的分布形状查询性能预测
translated_abstract: 标准的检索增强生成（RAG）流水线在推理时通常无法提供可靠的信号来判断检索是否成功；面对模糊或超出范围的查询时，生成过程可能因此产生幻觉。受捷克一家核监管机构的部署需求启发——由于数据敏感性而无法使用第三方LLM API——我们比较了三种用于评估RAG检索充分性的查询性能预测（QPP）范式：基于分数的特征、基于内容的LLM判别器，以及混合方法。在八个ViDoRe视觉领域（14,514条查询）上，我们的24个非词汇特征（GeneralQPP；包含15个分布形状特征、5个查询表面特征和4个全局特征）以每条查询仅2毫秒的速度达到加权平均AUROC 0.856，超越了经典QPP文献特征池（Classic Full，0.835），并远超本地部署的Qwen3.5 LLM判别器（0.649，差距+0.207；每条查询速度约快3000倍且成本更低）。将LLM判别作为单一特征加入（混合方法）在ViDoRe上可与S1持平（0.863），同时取得了具有统计学显著性的……
tldr: 本文提出由24个非词汇特征（以分布形状特征为主）构成的GeneralQPP方法，能以每条查询仅2毫秒的速度、0.856的AUROC判断RAG检索是否充分，性能超越经典QPP方法并大幅领先LLM判别器（快约3000倍），为隐私敏感的本地化部署场景提供了高效的检索充分性评估方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GeneralQPP, a set of 24 non-lexical features dominated by distribution-shape signals, which assesses RAG retrieval sufficiency with 0.856 AUROC at only 2ms per query—outperforming classic QPP methods and surpassing an LLM judge by ~3000× in speed and cost, enabling efficient privacy-preserving local deployment.
